prompt: Classify ONLY the latest request printed below. First decide whether it requests a new supplier template, an edit, a read, or continuation. An explicit supplier-template request always uses intent template even after a site/contact/address read. Prior pending requests and response text are reference context, never the current action. Resume a child clarification ONLY when the latest request merely supplies its missing supplier and does not ask for a new action. Classify the requested resource before classifying the read action. A READ request whose latest message asks for a supplier site, contact, or address uses intent children, including singular detail requests. intent detail means supplier-header details ONLY. The supplier mentioned in a child request is its parent, not the requested result. For "Show site details for site ID 300000047414699 for supplier number 1255": intent children, resource sites, matchMode number, term 1255, childMode id, childTerm 300000047414699. Apply the same separation to contact IDs and address IDs. Use resource contacts for contact detail and addresses for address detail. Never put a child ID in term or use intent detail when a child resource was requested. Extract the latest request: {{$context.$system.$inputMessage}}. Reference context only: supplier selection {{$context.$variables.supplierState.selection}}; draft {{$context.$variables.supplierState.draft}}; supplier candidates {{$context.$variables.supplierState.candidates}}; child candidates {{$context.$variables.supplierState.childCandidates}}; child selections {{$context.$variables.supplierState.childSelections}}; pending request {{$context.$variables.supplierState.pending}}; active read {{$context.$variables.supplierState.activeRead}}. Return intent (search, detail, children, template, edit, choices, next, unsupported), matchMode (contains, exact, number, id, selection), term (literal name/number/id or empty), newName (explicit new supplier name or empty), includeInactive (boolean), and patch with Supplier, SupplierType, BusinessRelationship, TaxOrganizationType, each explicit replacement string or null. Find a supplier like Dell => search/contains/Dell. Supplier number 1255 => number, never id. Create supplier based on Dell => template/contains/Dell. Create based on selected supplier => template/selection. If an editing draft exists and the user supplies its requested new name, use edit with patch.Supplier. Change only that name; retain unrelated classifications. Next page => next. An explicit candidate selection during an unresolved template request continues template with the selected displayed number or exact name. A separate read request must not change the draft source. Questions about valid supplier types, business relationships or tax organization types => choices. Do not invent available values. Explicit changes to these fields => edit with only the specified fields in patch; use the user's value as supplied. Supplier drafts preserve the approved SupplierType, BusinessRelationship and TaxOrganizationType inherited from the verified source. Missing classifications require explicit user input. Other optional-field or flexfield edits are unsupported. Related reads use intent=children and resource=sites/contacts/addresses. matchMode and term describe ONLY the parent supplier. childMode and childTerm describe ONLY the child: all for a collection, exact or contains for a child name, id for an explicitly supplied internal child key or a key from current same-parent childCandidates, selection for the single selected child, next for next resource page. Show sites for Dell => children/sites, parent contains Dell, childMode all. Show contacts for supplier number1255 => parent number1255. Show selected site details => sites/selection with parent selection. Find an address like Round Rock for Dell => addresses/contains childTerm Round Rock, parent contains Dell. Next sites page => children/sites/next. Bare Next page uses next and the deterministic current read owner. For supplier-only requests resource is empty, childMode all and childTerm empty. After a clarification for a child request, interpret an explicit supplier selection as children with the retained pending.childRequest resource/mode/term; never silently turn it into supplier-only detail. If no supplier is given use matchMode selection; do not invent one. For an independent new supplier search use search and do not resume a child request.  Site creation uses the site_template intent described below. Never copy a child key across parents. A request to create or copy a supplier site uses intent site_template, resource sites. matchMode/term identify ONLY the parent supplier; childMode/childTerm identify ONLY the source site; newName is ONLY the proposed new site name. Example: create a new site for Dell like Round Rock with new name Round Rock 2 => site_template, parent contains Dell, childMode contains, childTerm Round Rock, newName Round Rock 2. Create site based on the selected site with new name X => parent selection, childMode selection, newName X. If site-template clarification is pending and the latest message supplies a parent, source site ID, or requested new name, retain the other pending.siteRequest and pending.newName values and use site_template; never treat a source site ID as parent ID. For an existing site draft, a name change uses edit with patch.SupplierSite and all supplier-only patch fields null. For supplier drafts use patch.Supplier and patch.SupplierSite=null. All unspecified patch fields are null. Never infer a new request from old history or replace an explicit read with a create intent. Address/contact CREATE supports direct-entry and same-supplier template modes. For an explicit create/new/copy address or contact request use intent child_create, resource addresses or contacts, creationMode direct or template. Direct mode supplies required fields without a source child. Template mode explicitly asks based on/like/copy/from a source child; childMode/childTerm describe that source only. matchMode/term identify ONLY the parent supplier; absent parent uses selection. Selected address/contact uses parent selection and childMode selection, never a guessed parent. newName is the explicit mandatory NEW AddressName for address templates. Extract explicit values into childPatch: AddressName, CountryCode, AddressLine1, City, State, PostalCode, Email, FirstName, LastName; unspecified values are null. Address creation always orders; never extract purpose/account/security/generated/optional fields. Contact templates inherit FirstName, LastName, Email; explicit changes override only supplied required fields and a distinctive new identity is required. Address templates inherit required physical fields and current Email only; the new AddressName is explicit. Do not copy operational email into test data; use the user supplied controlled destination. Child field-only edits use intent edit and childPatch with only explicit replacements; never change an active draft parent from extraction. An explicit CREATE prepares only; it never authorizes submission. An ordinary read cannot become child_create. Keep existing supplier patch fields independent and null for child requests. If no source was requested use direct. Use creationMode empty and childPatch all null for other intents.
